question: Choose the word that is closest in meaning to the underlined word: "The movie was **awesome**."
explanation: “Awesome” significa increíble/genial. La opción más parecida es “Amazing”. Las otras dicen lo contrario o algo diferente.

question: Choose the word closest in meaning: "I need to **repair** my bike."
explanation: “Repair” = arreglar. “Fix” también significa arreglar. Es un sinónimo directo.

question: Choose the word closest in meaning: "She felt **sad** after the movie."
explanation: “Sad” = triste, y “Unhappy” = infeliz/triste. “Angry” es enojado y “Tired” es cansado.

question: Choose the word closest in meaning: "It was a **cheap** phone."
explanation: “Cheap” = barato. “Inexpensive” significa exactamente lo mismo. “Expensive” es lo contrario.

question: You see this sign at a swimming pool: "NO RUNNING". What does it mean?
explanation: El aviso "NO RUNNING" prohíbe correr: debes caminar. No dice que la piscina esté cerrada.

question: A store shows this sign: "SALE - 50% OFF". What can you do there?
explanation: "50% OFF" significa todo a mitad de precio. Es una oferta, no un empleo ni regalos.

question: On a door you read: "STAFF ONLY". Who can enter?
explanation: "Staff" = personal/empleados. Solo pueden entrar los trabajadores de ese lugar.

question: A concert ticket says: "SOLD OUT". What does it mean?
explanation: "Sold out" = agotado: ya no quedan boletas a la venta.

question: Complete the conversation: "Ana: I loved the concert! / Luis: _____"
options: Me too! The band was incredible
explanation: Ana dice que le encantó el concierto. "Me too" (a mí también) + un comentario positivo es la respuesta natural.

question: Complete: "Waiter: Are you ready to order? / Camilo: _____"
options: Yes, I would like a hamburger
The menu is on the table
explanation: El mesero pregunta si está listo para ordenar. Lo correcto es pedir comida: "Yes, I would like..."

question: Complete: "Sara: How was your weekend? / Juan: _____"
options: It was great! I played soccer with my cousins
explanation: La pregunta es sobre el FIN DE SEMANA en pasado. La respuesta correcta describe lo que hizo y usa pasado.

question: Complete: "Teacher: Why were you late? / Dani: _____"
options: Because the bus was late too
explanation: Preguntan POR QUÉ llegó tarde. La respuesta empieza con "Because" y da una razón en pasado.

question: Choose the correct option: "My sister _____ to the gym every day."
explanation: Tercera persona (my sister = she) en presente simple lleva -s: "goes". Regla básica del presente.

question: Choose the correct option: "They _____ playing video games right now."
explanation: "They" siempre va con "are" en presente continuo: They ARE playing.

question: Choose the correct option: "I _____ my homework yesterday."
explanation: "Yesterday" indica pasado simple: el pasado de "do" es "did".

question: Choose the correct option: "This is _____ book. Give it back!"
explanation: Antes de un sustantivo se usa el adjetivo posesivo "my". "Mine" va solo, sin sustantivo.

question: Read: "Mateo is from Barranquilla. He is 16 years old and loves swimming. He trains every morning before school." Where is Mateo from?
explanation: La primera oración lo dice directo: "Mateo is from Barranquilla". Pregunta literal, la respuesta está escrita.

question: Read: "The school library opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 4 p.m. It is closed on Sundays." When is the library open?
explanation: El texto dice: abre 7 a.m., cierra 4 p.m. Literal, solo hay que leer los horarios.

question: Read: "Luisa packed her swimsuit, sunscreen and a towel. Then she took the bus to the pool." You can infer that Luisa...
explanation: No lo dice directo, pero traje de baño + bloqueador + toalla + ir a la piscina = va a nadar. Eso es INFERIR.

question: Read: "Students should sleep at least 8 hours. Sleeping well improves memory and helps you get better grades." The main purpose of this text is to...
explanation: El texto da una recomendación y sus beneficios. El propósito es recomendar dormir bien.

explanation: "Silence please" pide silencio: hablar bajito o no hablar. Es un hospital, la gente necesita calma.

question: A park sign says: "KEEP THE PARK CLEAN". What is expected?
explanation: Throw trash in bins

question: Complete: "Paula: I failed the math test... / Camila: _____"
options: Don't worry! You can try again next time
explanation: Paula está triste por su nota. La respuesta amable es consolarla: "Don't worry, you can try again".

question: Complete: "David: Would you like to play soccer? / Tomás: _____"
options: I am reading a book now about it
explanation: Es una invitación con "Would you like...". La respuesta natural acepta: "Yes, I'd love to!".

question: Choose the correct option: "We _____ study for the ICFES."
explanation: "Must" nunca lleva -s ni formas extra: es un verbo modal, siempre va igual.

question: Choose the correct option: "She has lived here _____ 2010."
explanation: "Since" se usa con un punto en el tiempo (since 2010). "For" se usa con duraciones (for 10 years).

question: Choose the correct option: "There _____ many students in the classroom."
explanation: "Many students" es plural: se usa "There ARE". "There is" sería para uno solo.

question: Read: "Valentina plays the guitar every afternoon after school. She wants to be a musician." What does Valentina want to be?
explanation: El texto lo dice directo: "She wants to be a musician". Pregunta literal.

question: Read: "The zoo is open from Tuesday to Sunday. It is closed on Mondays." What days is the zoo closed?
explanation: El texto dice: cerrado los lunes. Solo los lunes.

question: Read: "Juan's clothes are wet and he is holding an umbrella." You can infer that...
explanation: Ropa mojada + sombrilla = está lloviendo. No lo dice el texto, pero la evidencia lo demuestra: eso es inferir.

question: Read: "Sara looked at the clock, grabbed her backpack and ran out of the house." You can infer that Sara is...
explanation: Miró el reloj y salió corriendo: se está demorando. La evidencia apunta a que va tarde.

question: Read: "Recycling one ton of paper saves 17 trees. If every student recycled their notebooks, our school would save hundreds of trees." The purpose of this text is to...

question: Read: "Many young people feel stressed during exam season. Experts recommend exercise, sleep and organizing study time." The text is mainly about...
explanation: El texto trata el estrés en exámenes y da recomendaciones de expertos: el tema es cómo manejarlo.
